entries.name: Wire brute
entries.line: The storm pulls the wire tight.

entries.name: Brill Quay
entries.line: Lake's this way. Watch your step on the wet planks.

entries.name: Kess Ellow
entries.line: No pole. Just a flick at the bright ring, then tug it in.

entries.name: Vesper Lin
entries.line: I have the watch. The pits are glowing.

entries.name: Tolla Reed
entries.line: Like this place? Pin it. I'll keep the gold dots on your map.

entries.name: Bram Cullet
entries.line: That deep pit is the hot one. Give it a wide walk.

entries.name: Mira Solace
entries.line: Fire's going. Come warm up, then head back out.

entries.name: Juno Volt
entries.line: Welcome to the bright streets. Stay on the lit hexes and you'll be fine.

entries.name: Pip Cinder
entries.line: Pick a game, win a prize from the shelf. What's on the card is what you get.

entries.name: Oren Drift
entries.line: Lean into it. The path is still there, just louder today.

entries.name: Nima Veil
entries.line: Stay close to my lantern. The town's only a few hexes off.

entries.name: Lumen Parr
entries.line: Warm cup, small snack. Sit a minute if the sun's out.

entries.name: Ivy Sable
entries.line: New color, new stamp. All washable. Pick what you like.

entries.name: Calder Wren
entries.line: Cells are for reloads, nothing else. I'll top you up.

entries.name: Pebble Finn
entries.line: Bait's in the tin. Your hands do the rest. I don't sell poles.

entries.name: Saffron Bumble
entries.line: Something small and sweet for the walk. No rush.

entries.name: Tavi Prism
entries.line: Hats and glow traces. Try one on. It comes right back off.

entries.name: Blink Solley
entries.line: The shelf is the list. Play, pick, take what's posted. That's the whole deal.

entries.name: Orra Flint
entries.line: Eat something before the next wave. I've got the easy stuff.
